title: Raw cone-presheaf adjunction and lifting preservation
statement:
Use simplicial sets, internal functor simplicial sets and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ and its ordered last-vertex cone from [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching], and the Kan model and model-category conventions of [lem-coef-simplicial-boundary-collapse-test]. Fix a small simplicial set $S$, enlarging universes when necessary, and put $D=\mathfrak C[S]^{\mathrm{op}}$. Let $\mathcal P_S$ be the category of simplicial functors $D\to\mathrm{sSet}$ and enriched natural transformations. An enriched natural transformation consists of maps at objects commuting with the simplicial action maps. This category has the projective model structure: weak equivalences are objectwise weak homotopy equivalences, fibrations are objectwise Kan fibrations, and cofibrations have the left lifting property against objectwise trivial Kan fibrations; factorizations are functorial. Its mapping simplicial set $\underline{\operatorname{Nat}}(F,G)$ has degree-$n$ simplices the enriched natural maps $F\times\Delta^n\to G$. A projectively fibrant presheaf is one taking values in Kan complexes; projectively cofibrant means that its initial map is a projective cofibration.

For $a:X\to S$ put $T_a=\mathfrak C[X\star\Delta^0]\amalg_{\mathfrak C[X]}\mathfrak C[S]$, with cone vertex $v$, and define $L_S(X)(s)=T_a(s,v)$, with action by precomposition. Define $U_S(F)\to S$ by declaring its degree-$n$ simplices over $\sigma:\Delta^n\to S$ to be enriched natural transformations $L_S(\Delta^n\xrightarrow{\sigma}S)\to F$; simplex operators are restriction. These are an ordinary adjunction $L_S\dashv U_S$. The functor $L_S$ sends every degreewise monomorphism over $S$ to a projective cofibration. If $f:(X,a)\to(Y,b)$ induces a Dwyer--Kan equivalence on $\mathfrak C[S\amalg_X(X\star\Delta^0)]\to\mathfrak C[S\amalg_Y(Y\star\Delta^0)]$, then $L_S(f)$ is an objectwise weak homotopy equivalence. Here Dwyer--Kan means weak homotopy equivalences on all mapping simplicial sets and equivalence on the categories of their path components. These assertions make no assumption of a model structure on $\mathrm{sSet}_{/S}$ and no quasicategory assumption on $S$.
